steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huff... Puff... I never thought we would have to face a monster like this...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: All thanks to that Ted— ***, He's hiding away so well! Is he this scared of having revenge taken on him?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is it. The armed doctors are all defeated, no one will get in our way now.
You take one last look at the "monster." Or rather, "Brand," who has fallen to the ground. Its pupils are gradually glazed, but he is still muttering.

steps.speaker: Brand
steps.content: I'll... save... you guys... I... will...
You get a little closer and take one last look at "Brand" fallen to the ground. Its pupils are gradually glazed, but he is still muttering.

steps.speaker: Brand
steps.content: I'll... save... you guys... I... will...
For a split second, he exudes a scent similar to Sinners.
A metal tube as long as a finger rolls toward you guys and gradually comes to a halt. Psss—the holes on the two ends begin to jet out some strange gas.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What's this?! Don't breathe it in, ${PlayerName}! Don't——
She lunges at you with a pale face, but before she reaches you. A powerful force yanks her away, then her voice suddenly halts.
You try to reach out but find that your hand isn't raised as high as you want. Your vision starts to blur and then suddenly drops.
You try to avoid the suspicious gas, but you fail to keep your balance and fall back. You can't even feel the pain from falling.
You want to shout, but your mouth can't do it, as if your mind has been separated from the rest of the body. The blurred and shaky vision is the last thing you cling to.
And welcome to SALVA... Chief Lapdog.
